comment: Example ids (folder names under examples/) that run in CI. needs_api_key examples run only when the SCRAPINGANT_API_KEY secret is set.

examples.note: 04 is skipped without the key
00/01/03 run without a key; 02 skipped without it
starts local proxies; needs curl and outbound HTTPS
starts a local self-signed HTTPS server; needs openssl and outbound HTTPS

starts a local echo server; needs wget and curl
local self-signed and expired HTTPS servers; case 07 result depends on the wget TLS backend

Default run checks three local Python Chromium fixture adapters only; CI uses bundled Chromium. --all also needs Node dependencies, a separate Camoufox environment and its Firefox builds. Dated public detector observations are not monthly pass/fail gates.

Default checks use public Google/Turnstile test keys and real verification endpoints plus three SDK import/preflight checks. No paid solving, audio demo trials or ScrapingAnt request in monthly CI; production solving is not measured.
about 190 credits per run with LATENCY_N=3 (set in the workflow env); 04 and 07 are informational; needs Node 22 for the TypeScript script

Local HTTPS catalog,16 offline safety/oracle assertions and 3 Chrome rounds. Needs Chrome/Selenium Manager and openssl; no API calls even if a key exists. Firefox and bounded product probe are explicit opt-ins.
Local synthetic catalog and bundled Chromium by default; optional Firefox captures are documented. No external target or API call, even when a key is configured.
Local synthetic catalog, Requests cookie scope/persistence matrix and offline regressions. No external target or API call, even when a key is configured.
Local catalog, three bundled Chromium rounds and strict capture/oracle tests. Firefox is an explicit local option. No API calls or external targets.
Local catalog, three Chrome rounds and 22 regression tests. Needs Chrome/Selenium Manager; Firefox is an explicit option. No API calls or external targets.
Local catalog, three bundled Chrome rounds and 24 boundary tests. Needs Node22.12+ and npm ci. No API calls or external targets.
Local synthetic catalog; three Chrome rounds, strict tuple/oracle regressions and stale recovery. No API calls. Firefox is opt-in.
Local synthetic catalog in bundled Chromium and Firefox; three rounds, readiness/locator controls and strict capture regressions. No API calls.
Local synthetic catalog; three Chrome rounds, structured record and whole-page text cases. No API calls.
Local DOM-to-JSON transport checks and offline replay of saved responses. Never calls the API by default; live six-call probe is explicit opt-in.
Owned local HTML-to-JSON fixtures and oracle checks; no API calls.
Owned ads.txt/sellers.json diagnostic fixtures; standard library; no network or API calls.
Loopback HTTP failure matrix, bounded retries and SQLite sink. No external targets or API calls; cooperative timing tolerances are explicit.
Offline validator controls and replay of five MCP retrievals plus 15 Anthropic responses. No API calls; live acquisition/generation are explicit opt-ins.
Owned offline JSON snapshots and response-acceptance regressions. Standard library only; no network/API calls even if a key is configured.
